alert.name: warden-dev-mobile-http-api-5xx
alert.summary: 5xx responses on the mobile HTTP API above 20 per minute

logs: ALARM AWS/ApiGateway/5xx ApiId=k7x2m9q4ab stat=Sum period=60s threshold GreaterThanThreshold 20.0 datapoints=2/3 missing=notBreaching state=ALARM
tool_errors: logs: alarm-siblings metrics: [throttled on GetMetricData] An error occurred (Throttling) when calling the GetMetricData operation (reached max retries: 0): Rate exceeded
logs: changes: [throttled on LookupEvents] An error occurred (ThrottlingException) when calling the LookupEvents operation (reached max retries: 0): Rate exceeded
context.alert_text: 5xx responses on the mobile HTTP API above 20 per minute

root_cause.hypothesis: The API Gateway (k7x2m9q4ab) crossed its 5xx error threshold (388 sum vs 20 threshold), but the evidence needed to explain why (sibling alarm metrics and recent change/deploy history) could not be retrieved because GetMetricData and LookupEvents calls were throttled. Without visibility into recent deploys, config changes, or backend health, no specific root cause (bad deploy, backend outage, integration failure, throttling) can be established — only that a real 5xx spike occurred.
evidence: Diagnostic reads for siblings and recent changes both failed (T1, T2), making the actual trigger unknown rather than ruled out
